optimizedDescription.value: Lists specs across ordered workspaces with optional self-healed summaries and no metadata-status exposure.

optimizedContext.value:
# List Specs

## Rules

- `ListSpecs.execute(options?)`: obtain workspaces through `ListWorkspaces`; filter workspace names before calls; invoke each `specRepo.list(options)`.
- Forward identical `ListOptions` and `includeSummary`; never forward metadata-status flag or add default `limit`; never re-sort, re-filter, or re-paginate repository results.
- Merge in workspace declaration order; retain repository canonical path order. Cross-workspace pagination excluded; paginate single workspace or filter explicitly.
- Every `SpecListEntry`: required `workspace`, `path`, `title` from `SpecRepository.list()`; no extra title metadata/file reads.
- `includeSummary: true`: use repository result only. `FsSpecIndexCache`/index rebuild self-heals metadata with `policy: if-needed`, then projects normalized `description`, or fresh `optimizedDescription` when `llmOptimizedContext` active.
- Missing/stale `optimizedDescription`: fall back to normalized `description`. Unavailable projection: omit `summary`; do not fail listing.
- `includeSummary` false/omitted: omit `summary` from every entry; repository listing must not trigger summary materialization.
- Optional title/summary projection errors remain isolated in repository/index path; omit failed optional projection; never abort merge or propagate optional-field I/O errors.
- Never expose `metadataStatus`; never filter by metadata freshness.
- `createListSpecs(config, options?)`: derive `ListSpecsDeps` via `resolveListSpecsDeps(resolver)`, then delegate to canonical `createListSpecs(deps)`.
- `resolveListSpecsDeps(resolver)` resolves only `listWorkspaces: ListWorkspaces`; never resolve `getMetadata`, `materializeMetadata`, `hasher: ContentHasher`, or `yaml: YamlSerializer`; never reconstruct fs wiring inline.

## Constraints

- Never modify repositories.
- Depend on `ListWorkspaces` for project traversal.
- Title requires no redundant I/O.
- Summary materialization occurs only inside repository/index boundary when requested; stale optimized values prohibited.
- Metadata freshness projection/filtering prohibited.
